clue.text: Pink with increasing rage

definitions.meaning: a plant yielding a pinkish-red dye, and the dye itself
more angry, the comparative of a word for furious

explanation.definitionFit: The plant's root gives a rosy dye, and the same spelling is the comparative of 'mad', meaning angrier.

clue.text: Contemplate changing meat diet

indicators.note: changing tells us the letters of meat diet are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone thinks about switching to a different meat-based diet.
explanation.definitionFit: To ponder something deeply is a synonym for thinking it over quietly.

clue.text: Find that the record has finished

parts.note: a record is a gramophone disc
over means finished or ended

explanation.surface: Someone learns that the music has come to an end.
explanation.definitionFit: To find something hitherto unknown is to uncover it, a direct synonym.

clue.text: English cleric gets upset all the time

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset means the word for the cleric is turned upside down, so read backwards

parts.note: Rev, short for Reverend, is a clergyman

explanation.surface: An English vicar is perpetually upset.
explanation.definitionFit: Always and constantly are synonyms of this word, as in 'for ever'.

clue.text: Non-continental admits to character assassination

parts.note: someone admitting to a deed says 'I' did it, the first-person pronoun of confession
slander is a damaging spoken attack on someone's reputation

explanation.surface: A person from an island confesses to smearing someone's name.
explanation.walkthrough: The confession 'I slander' gives the letters: the person admitting is I.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone living on an island such as Britain is not a mainland continental.

clue.text: Dad and sister made to conform

indicators.note: made here means formed or fashioned, so the letters of dad and sister are refashioned

explanation.surface: A father and his sister were forced to fit in with everyone else.
explanation.walkthrough: All twelve letters of 'Dad and sister', including 'and', are rearranged; the definition reads 'made to conform' loosely, with 'made' doing the anagram work.
explanation.definitionFit: Something brought into line with a set norm has been regularised to a uniform pattern.

clue.text: Register a light love-letter

parts.note: the letter that means love, nil in tennis scores, is O

explanation.surface: Someone records a light-hearted love letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A singing voice range, the one below soprano, is a vocal register.

clue.text: The German consuming a pub meal

indicators.note: consuming means eating up, so the German article swallows the pub

parts.note: der is a German word for 'the'
an inn is a pub

explanation.surface: A German man eats a meal at the local pub.
explanation.definitionFit: The main evening meal is a specific kind of meal.

clue.text: Reprimand a seaman

definitions.meaning: a non-commissioned sailor in the Royal Navy

explanation.definitionFit: A severe telling-off is a dated sense of the word, and naval ordinary sailors are also so called.

clue.text: Father embraced a woman and took off

indicators.note: embraced means hugged, so the word for father encloses the woman

parts.note: dad is an informal word for father
she stands for a woman

explanation.surface: A dad hugged a woman and then ran away.
explanation.definitionFit: To rush off hurriedly is to dart away, so took off means hurried away.

clue.text: Start fishing-for a snapper!

definitions.meaning: to begin trawling by throwing a mesh out over the water
a clicking percussion instrument held in the hand

explanation.definitionFit: Throwing a mesh is how a trawler begins fishing, and the Spanish clicking instrument snaps.

clue.text: Networking in Civvy Street

parts.note: read 'Networking' as N-ot working, and Civvy Street as civilian life, out of the forces

explanation.walkthrough: Civvy Street is British slang for civilian life after military service.
explanation.definitionFit: A machine not working is said to be unavailable for use, and a demobbed soldier is no longer in the forces.

clue.text: Use the horn anyway

indicators.note: anyway means the word reads the same any way round, forwards or backwards

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.definitionFit: To give a short blast on a car or trumpet is to hoot.

clue.text: Issued equipment containing leather-wear

indicators.note: containing means the words Issued equipment hold the letters within them

explanation.surface: Kit handed out includes leather clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Napped calfskin used for shoes and jackets is a kind of leather.

clue.text: Ignoble purpose

explanation.definitionFit: A base or stingy act is shabby, and to intend something is a synonym of the verb.

clue.text: Way to take metal into repository

parts.note: St, short for street, is a way
ore is metal-bearing rock

explanation.surface: A route for carrying metal into a warehouse.
explanation.definitionFit: A warehouse or depot where goods are kept is a repository.

clue.text: Picture that is to provide cover for journal

indicators.note: to provide cover for means the letters for that is wrap around the journal

parts.note: i.e. is the Latin abbreviation meaning that is
mag, short for magazine, is a journal

explanation.surface: A photograph meant for a magazine's front cover.
explanation.definitionFit: A likeness or representation is a synonym of a picture.

clue.text: Form Tory team for English EC agreement

indicators.note: form means shape or arrange, so the letters are put into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A team of Conservatives assembles to produce a European agreement for England.
explanation.definitionFit: The 1957 accord founding the European Economic Community, forerunner of the EC, was signed in the Italian capital.

clue.text: Permit one tour to go ahead without restraint

parts.note: let means allow or permit
I is the Roman numeral one
a trip is a tour or journey

explanation.surface: Allow a single holiday to proceed freely.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to allow something full rein, unchecked.

clue.text: Adroitly manoeuvred to win hero-worship

indicators.note: manoeuvred means moved around, so the letters of adroitly are shifted about

explanation.surface: Someone skilfully steered things to gain adoring admiration.
explanation.definitionFit: Worship of images, and by extension excessive adulation of a person, is idol worship.

clue.text: Urgent requirement, at least for crumpled clothes

definitions.meaning: creased garments want ironing, a need for pressing

explanation.definitionFit: Urgent means pressing, and creased garments literally need ironing.

clue.text: Rank must have been Detective Chief Superintendent

definitions.meaning: foul-smelling or off, as stale butter

definitions.text: must have been Detective Chief Superintendent
definitions.meaning: a senior detective presumably headed, or ran, the Criminal Investigation Department

explanation.walkthrough: Split as RAN CID: a Detective Chief Superintendent ran the CID, the Criminal Investigation Department of a British police force.
explanation.definitionFit: Rank as an adjective means foul or putrid, like butter gone off.

clue.text: Declare porter to be full of energy

indicators.note: to be full of means the beer holds the energy symbol inside

parts.note: porter is a dark beer, like stout
E is the symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Say that dark ale is invigorating.
explanation.definitionFit: To state or present an argument formally is a phrasal synonym of declare.

clue.text: Not where Lincoln died!

parts.note: Abraham Lincoln was shot at Ford's Theatre, not at home tucked up for the night

explanation.definitionFit: The word means in one's sleeping place, where Lincoln was not when he was shot.

clue.text: Terse instruction to an advocate

definitions.meaning: a solicitor's instructions to a barrister setting out the case

explanation.definitionFit: Concise speech is short, and a barrister's case papers carry the same name.

clue.text: The police account?

definitions.meaning: an invoice or reckoning to be paid

explanation.definitionFit: British slang names the police the Old Bill, and an invoice is an account.

clue.text: If served it, a vegetarian might complain

definitions.text: If served it, a vegetarian might complain

parts.words: If served it, a vegetarian might complain
parts.note: a meat a non-meat-eater would refuse, and a slang verb for grumbling

explanation.definitionFit: Meat from cattle would upset a vegetarian, and as slang the word means grumble.

clue.text: Henry has a large manor-house

parts.note: Hal is a familiar form of Henry

explanation.surface: Henry owns a big country house.
explanation.definitionFit: A large country house, as in a stately home's name, is a manor-house.

clue.text: Shut up the racket as one got nearer

definitions.meaning: confined a noisy business behind walls
approached, the way an enemy surrounds

explanation.definitionFit: Enclosed and approached are both senses of the phrasal verb: walls confine, and pursuers draw near.

clue.text: Room where fish needs to soak

parts.note: the gar is a long-snouted fish
to ret flax is to soak it

explanation.surface: A place where a fish has to be steeped.
explanation.definitionFit: An attic room at the top of a house is a kind of room.

clue.text: Not taxed with work

parts.note: free of import levies, or free of obligations and chores

explanation.definitionFit: Goods exempt from customs levies are free of a tax duty, and the clue's 'work' plays on another sense of duty.

clue.text: Untidy agent about to trim down

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the agent goes round the word for cutting

parts.note: a spy is a secret agent
to lop is to cut back branches

explanation.surface: A scruffy spy is about to slim down.
explanation.definitionFit: Careless and messy work is slapdash, a synonym of untidy.
